listing.name: Customizable Regalia
listing.summary: Yea, this. Makes Regalia from Tahlan Shipworks behave like Virtuous from Diable Avionics. Safe to add to existing save file, not safe to remove (duh). Enjoy your Accelerated Ammo Feeder mechs with two energy weapons I guess.
listing.aiSummary: Changes the Regalia mech to function like the Virtuous mech.

description: Modifies the Regalia from Tahlan Shipworks so it behaves similarly to the Virtuous from Diable Avionics. This allows for mechs equipped with Accelerated Ammo Feeders and two energy weapons.
